items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Close up. I played a quite a few jobs. Mm-hmm. Yeah, I was with Louis.

ctx.x: Were you in the tuxedo before Louis Armstrong or after him?
Oh, no, I was in there. Short after. Short after. Yeah. Close up. I played a quite a few jobs. Mm-hmm. Yeah, I was with Louis. With that band?

items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: Well, well the band consisted of me, Louis Armstrong, George Washington, and they, Joe Rene.

ctx.x: Yeah, I heard somebody that did that there. It'd be terrible in the warm weather already. Yeah, yeah, in the warm weather. In the warm weather.

And then, and then again, I kept on and my mother wanted me to play piano. Because all my brothers and sisters could play. All accepted me. Because she taught. But to me, she tried to teach me but I couldn't go for no piano. I didn't like piano. I used to like a plenty of noise. And so I just dove to drums. Until, until we made up a band. On failure between Howard and Ferrette. I had a boy's house named Richard Taylor. Well, well the band consisted of me, Louis Armstrong, George Washington, and they, Joe Rene.…
